fusions.name: Jaw and Tail
fusions.desc: You bite ahead and lash behind at once, and every enemy within 2.5 tiles takes a hit that deals 12 damage and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Spare Tooth
fusions.desc: Spits one of your teeth at an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, using that affliction up; the tooth deals 8 damage, then splits to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Blame Elsewhere
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Second Row
fusions.desc: Conjures a second row of teeth onto your weapon: your weapon deals 10% more damage, you attack 6% faster, and each strike leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
